create_empty_image_of_size: create an empty RGB image with a specified width and height tuple
crop_screenshot: crop a screenshot image to a given width and height from the top-left corner
add_cursor_to_screenshot: add a cursor graphic onto a screenshot image at the cursor position with offset adjustment
augment_screenshot_with_marker: augment a screenshot image by rendering a red square marker in the upper right corner
render_action_history_header: render a yellow header with action history text on top of a screenshot image
